instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Applies to every workplace on land, underground, on or under water and in the air within Indonesian jurisdiction, expressly including construction, repair, maintenance and demolition of buildings and structures, irrigation works and tunnels.
summary.zh: 适用于印度尼西亚管辖范围内陆地、地下、水上水下及空中的一切工作场所，明确包括建筑物与构筑物的建造、修缮、维护和拆除，以及灌溉工程和隧道。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Implementing regulations set safety requirements covering accident and fire prevention, explosion control, escape routes, first aid, personal protective equipment and control of heat, dust, noise and occupational disease.
summary.zh: 实施条例须就事故与火灾预防、防爆、逃生通道、急救、个人防护装备以及高温、粉尘、噪声和职业病控制等制定安全要求。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Managers must check the physical and mental fitness of new and transferred workers and arrange periodic health examinations by an approved doctor.
summary.zh: 管理者须检查新入职及调岗工人的身心健康状况，并安排经批准的医生进行定期健康检查。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Managers must explain workplace hazards, safeguards, protective equipment and safe methods to each new worker before employing them, and must run training on accident prevention, fire fighting and first aid.
summary.zh: 管理者须在用工前向每名新工人说明工作场所危害、防护措施、防护装备和安全作业方法，并须开展事故预防、消防和急救培训。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: The Minister may establish a joint occupational safety and health committee (P2K3) to build cooperation between management and workers on safety.
summary.zh: 部长可设立职业安全健康联合委员会（P2K3），促进管理层与工人在安全方面的合作。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Managers must report every accident in their workplace to the official designated by the Minister, following the prescribed procedure.
summary.zh: 管理者须按规定程序将其工作场所发生的每起事故报告部长指定的官员。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Workers must give truthful information to inspectors, use required protective equipment and follow safety rules, and may object to work where safety conditions are doubtful.
summary.zh: 工人须如实向监察员提供信息、使用规定的防护装备并遵守安全规则，并可对安全条件存疑的工作提出异议。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 1 of 1970 on Work Safety (UU 1/1970 Keselamatan Kerja)

summary.en: Managers must post the safety requirements and the law in visible places, display safety signs, and provide required protective equipment free of charge to workers and visitors.
summary.zh: 管理者须在显眼处张贴安全要求及本法，展示安全标识，并免费向工人和访客提供规定的防护装备。

currency_note: Read from a Wikisource transcription; implementing regulations (e.g. PP 50/2012 SMK3) not yet in this library.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

heading.en: Security, Safety, Health and Sustainability Standards (K4)
heading.zh: 安全、保安、健康与可持续标准（K4）

summary.en: Defines the K4 standards as technical guidelines on workplace security, safety and health in construction, social protection of workers, and local environmental management.
summary.zh: 将K4标准界定为关于施工工作场所保安、安全与健康、工人社会保障以及当地环境管理的技术指南。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

heading.zh: 优先使用国内建筑资源

summary.en: Construction resources should be prioritised from domestic production.
summary.zh: 建筑资源应优先采用国内产品。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: A foreign construction business operating in Indonesia must form a representative office and/or an Indonesian legal entity through a capital partnership with a national construction firm; further rules on joint operations and greater use of Indonesian workers are set by ministerial regulation (Pasal 35).
summary.zh: 在印尼经营的外国建筑企业须设立代表处，和/或通过与本国建筑企业合资设立印尼法人；联合经营及更多使用印尼工人的具体规定由部长条例规定（第35条）。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: The official explanatory note describes the mandatory contract contents: party identities, scope (volume, administrative and technical requirements, insurance or guarantees, progress reports), contract value and time including maintenance, information the owner must provide such as permits and site handover, and payment terms.
summary.zh: 官方释义说明施工合同须载明：当事方身份、工作范围（工程量、行政与技术要求、保险或保函、进度报告）、合同价款与包括维护期在内的工期、业主须提供的信息（如建筑许可和场地移交文件）以及付款方式。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: Per the explanatory note, sub-providers may be engaged through subcontracts where specialist expertise is needed, without reducing the main provider's responsibility for the whole of the work.
summary.zh: 依官方释义，因专业技术需要可通过分包合同引入分包方，但不减轻总包方对全部工作成果的责任。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

heading.en: Building failure assessed by expert assessors

summary.en: Building failure after final handover is determined by expert assessors in construction, appointed to keep the assessment objective.
summary.zh: 最终移交后的建筑失效须由建筑领域的专家评估人认定，以确保评估客观。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: Construction workers in operator, technician or analyst, and expert positions must hold a competency certificate (per the explanatory note).
summary.zh: 依官方释义，担任操作员、技术员或分析员及专家岗位的施工人员须持有资格证书。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: Employers of foreign construction workers must have a foreign-worker utilisation plan approved by the manpower ministry and a permit to employ foreign workers; foreign workers are limited to certain positions such as commissioners, directors, managers and specified experts.
summary.zh: 雇用外籍施工人员的雇主须持有经人力部批准的外籍劳工使用计划及雇用许可；外籍人员仅限于董事、经理及特定专家等岗位。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Law No. 2 of 2017 on Construction Services (UU 2/2017 Jasa Konstruksi)

summary.en: Construction contract disputes are resolved first by deliberation, then through mechanisms including mediation, conciliation and arbitration; parties may agree from the outset to a dispute board to prevent and mediate disputes during the contract.
summary.zh: 施工合同争议首先通过协商解决，再通过调解、和解及仲裁等机制解决；双方可自订约时约定设立争议委员会，在合同履行中预防和调处争议。

currency_note: Amended by the Job Creation law (UU 11/2020, replaced by UU 6/2023), which moved business licensing to risk-based Perizinan Berusaha via OSS; licensing articles are therefore omitted and other articles must be checked against the amended text.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

summary.en: Every service user (owner) and service provider must apply the construction safety management system across consultancy, construction and integrated works.
summary.zh: 所有业主和服务提供方均须在咨询、施工及一体化工程中实施建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

heading.en: Elements of SMKK and the construction safety plan

summary.en: The provider must prepare a construction safety plan (RKK); SMKK has five elements: leadership and worker participation, planning, support, operations, and performance evaluation.
summary.zh: 服务提供方须编制施工安全计划（RKK）；SMKK包括五个要素：领导与员工参与、策划、支持、运行和绩效评价。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

summary.en: The construction safety plan is a tender requirement and must be updated into an implementation plan after contract award.
summary.zh: 施工安全计划是投标要求的一部分，中标后须更新为实施版计划。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

summary.en: Under lowest-price evaluation a bid without an SMKK cost estimate is disqualified; SMKK cost must be included in the owner's estimate and covers items such as the safety plan, PPE, insurance and permits, safety staff and traffic devices (Pasal 23 and 40).
summary.zh: 在最低价评标中，未报SMKK费用的投标将被淘汰；SMKK费用须列入业主估价，涵盖安全计划、个人防护装备、保险与许可、安全人员及交通设施等（第23条和第40条）。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

summary.en: The owner sets the risk level: small (owner's estimate up to Rp10 billion, under 25 workers), medium (above Rp10 billion to Rp100 billion, 25 to 100 workers) or large (above Rp100 billion, over 100 workers, or using heavy lifting equipment or blasting).
summary.zh: 风险等级由业主确定：小（估价不超过100亿印尼盾、少于25名工人）、中（100亿至1000亿印尼盾、25至100名工人）、大（超过1000亿印尼盾、超过100名工人，或使用重型吊装设备或爆破）。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

summary.en: The provider must form a construction safety unit reporting to top management, led by a certified person and staffed with construction safety experts or officers (Pasal 36-37).
summary.zh: 服务提供方须设立直属最高管理层的施工安全单位（UKK），由持证人员领导，并配备施工安全专家或安全员（第36至37条）。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 10 of 2021 on Construction Safety Management System (Permen PUPR 10/2021 SMKK)
instrument_zh: 2021年第10号公共工程与住房部长条例《建筑安全管理体系（SMKK）指南》

heading.en: Supervision and the Construction Safety Committee
heading.zh: 监督与施工安全委员会

summary.en: The Minister supervises SMKK implementation and establishes the Construction Safety Committee (Komite Keselamatan Konstruksi).
summary.zh: 部长负责监督SMKK实施，并设立施工安全委员会（Komite Keselamatan Konstruksi）。

currency_note: Read from a third-party mirror marked as not yet reviewed; appendices (lampiran) were not read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: Specific personal data includes health, biometric, genetic, criminal record, children's and personal financial data; general data includes name, gender, religion, marital status and combined identifying data.
summary.zh: 特定个人数据包括健康、生物识别、基因、犯罪记录、儿童及个人财务数据；一般数据包括姓名、性别、宗教、婚姻状况及组合可识别数据。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: Controllers need a lawful basis: explicit consent, contract performance, legal obligation, vital interests, public interest or service, or legitimate interests.
summary.zh: 控制者须有合法依据：明示同意、履行合同、法律义务、重大利益、公共利益或公共服务，或正当利益。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: A data protection impact assessment is required for high-risk processing, including automated decisions with significant effect, specific data, large-scale processing, systematic monitoring and new technology.
summary.zh: 高风险处理须开展数据保护影响评估，包括具有重大影响的自动化决策、特定数据、大规模处理、系统性监控和新技术应用。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: Controllers must protect personal data with technical and operational measures at a security level suited to the nature and risk of the data (with confidentiality, oversight and access-control duties in Pasal 36-39).
summary.zh: 控制者须采取与数据性质和风险相适应的技术与运营措施保护个人数据（第36至39条另规定保密、监督和访问控制义务）。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: On a failure of personal data protection the controller must notify data subjects and the agency in writing within 3 x 24 hours, stating the data exposed, when and how it happened, and remediation; in some cases the public must be informed.
summary.zh: 发生个人数据保护失效时，控制者须在3×24小时内书面通知数据主体及主管机构，说明泄露的数据、发生时间与方式及补救措施；特定情形下须告知公众。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU 27/2022 PDP)
instrument_zh: 2022年第27号法律《个人数据保护法》

summary.en: A data protection officer is required for public-service processing, large-scale systematic monitoring, or large-scale processing of specific or criminal data; the officer may be internal or external.
summary.zh: 为公共服务处理数据、开展大规模系统性监控，或大规模处理特定数据或犯罪数据的，须设数据保护官，可为内部或外部人员。

authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
currency_note: Constitutional Court decision 151/PUU-XXII/2024 reads Pasal 53(1)(b) 'dan' as 'dan/atau'; implementing regulation not yet read.

instrument: Law No. 23 of 2007 on Railways (UU 23/2007 Perkeretaapian)

heading.zh: 铁路基础设施运营方的许可

summary.en: A railway infrastructure operator needs a business permit, a construction permit (issued after technical requirements are met) and an operating permit (issued after operational fitness is met), from the national, provincial or district government depending on the line's extent.
summary.zh: 铁路基础设施运营方须取得经营许可、建设许可（满足技术要求后签发）和运营许可（满足运行适用性后签发），按线路范围由中央、省或县市政府签发。

version: Original text (2007); amended by the Job Creation law
currency_note: Original 2007 text read from Wikisource; permit articles may have been changed by the Job Creation law (UU 6/2023).

instrument: Law No. 23 of 2007 on Railways (UU 23/2007 Perkeretaapian)

summary.en: A railway line comprises a right-of-way space (ruang manfaat) closed to the public, an ownership space (ruang milik) and a supervision space (ruang pengawasan) where other uses must not endanger operations (Pasal 36-47).
summary.zh: 铁路线路包括不向公众开放的使用空间（ruang manfaat）、所有权空间（ruang milik）和监管空间（ruang pengawasan），在监管空间内的其他用途不得危及运营（第36至47条）。

version: Original text (2007); amended by the Job Creation law
currency_note: Original 2007 text read from Wikisource; permit articles may have been changed by the Job Creation law (UU 6/2023).

instrument: Law No. 23 of 2007 on Railways (UU 23/2007 Perkeretaapian)

summary.en: Crossings between railways and roads are to be grade-separated; level crossings are exceptional and allowed only where safety and traffic flow are maintained, trains have priority, and unpermitted crossings must be closed (Pasal 90-94).
summary.zh: 铁路与道路交叉原则上须立体交叉；平交道口仅在确保安全与交通顺畅时例外允许，列车享有优先权，未经许可的道口须予关闭（第90至94条）。

version: Original text (2007); amended by the Job Creation law
currency_note: Original 2007 text read from Wikisource; permit articles may have been changed by the Job Creation law (UU 6/2023).

instrument: Law No. 23 of 2007 on Railways (UU 23/2007 Perkeretaapian)

heading.en: Building roads or facilities across a railway
heading.zh: 跨越铁路修建道路或设施

summary.en: Building a road or other facility that crosses or meets a railway requires the infrastructure owner's permission, and the permit holder is responsible for the crossing's construction, operation, maintenance and safety.
summary.zh: 修建跨越或接入铁路的道路或其他设施须取得基础设施所有方许可，许可持有人负责该交叉设施的建设、运营、维护与安全。

version: Original text (2007); amended by the Job Creation law
currency_note: Original 2007 text read from Wikisource; permit articles may have been changed by the Job Creation law (UU 6/2023).

instrument: Law No. 23 of 2007 on Railways (UU 23/2007 Perkeretaapian)

summary.en: After an accident the operator must take safety measures, care for victims, report to the Minister and local government, inform the public and restore traffic after initial police investigation.
summary.zh: 事故发生后，运营方须采取安全措施、救护受害者、向部长及地方政府报告、告知公众，并在警方初步调查后恢复通行。

version: Original text (2007); amended by the Job Creation law
currency_note: Original 2007 text read from Wikisource; permit articles may have been changed by the Job Creation law (UU 6/2023).
